title: Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 passed; bank operational 1 Apr 1935
Banking Companies Act, 1949 (renamed Banking Regulation Act, 1966) gives RBI licensing and supervision of banks
Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation Act, 1961
DICGC constituted from merger of Deposit Insurance Corporation (1962) and Credit Guarantee Corporation (1971)
NABARD Act, 1981 enacted
NABARD established (12 Jul 1982)
National Housing Bank Act, 1987 enacted
NHB established 9 Jul 1988
SEBI set up as a non-statutory administrative body
SIDBI Act, 1989 enacted
SIDBI began operations 2 Apr 1990
SEBI Act, 1992 — statutory powers granted after the 1992 securities scam
IRDA Act, 1999 — insurance opened; IRDAI constituted 2000 (HQ Hyderabad)
PFRDA set up as interim executive authority (GO)
NPCI incorporated as Section 8 company by RBI and IBA
Financial Stability and Development Council created by executive resolution — non-statutory
PFRDA Act, 2013 enacted (statutory w.e.f. 1 Feb 2014)
Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 enacted
IBBI constituted 1 Oct 2016
HFC regulation moved from NHB to RBI (9 Aug 2019)
IFSCA Act, 2019 enacted — unified regulator for GIFT IFSC
IFSCA operational from 1 Oct 2020 (supersedes sectoral regulators inside the IFSC)
Deposit insurance cover raised to Rs 5 lakh per depositor per bank (4 Feb 2020)
RBI releases draft SRO framework for the fintech sector (Jan 2024) — tracked in SROTrac
FACE recognised as first RBI SRO-FT (28 Aug 2024) — tracked in SROTrac
Tuhin Kanta Pandey appointed SEBI Chairperson (Feb 2025), succeeding Madhabi Puri Buch
Poonam Gupta appointed RBI Deputy Governor (Apr 2025)
Sivasubramanian Ramann assumes charge as PFRDA Chairperson (20 Jun 2025)
Ajay Seth appointed IRDAI Chairperson (24 Jul 2025), succeeding Debasish Panda
Shirish Chandra Murmu appointed RBI Deputy Governor (Oct 2025)
Sandip Pradhan inducted as SEBI Whole-Time Member (Dec 2025)
IBBI Grievance and Complaint Handling (Amendment) Regulations, 2026 notified (25 Feb 2026)
IBC Amendment Act 2026 bars resolution professionals from acting as liquidators in the same matter
IBBI opens search for next Chairperson — succession process starts early under incumbent Ravi Mital
Calcutta High Court holds IBBI Chairperson cannot act as the Disciplinary Committee under IBC
Corporate Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026 Clause 73 proposes IBBI as statutory valuation authority
K. Rajaraman's IFSCA chair tenure extended till Oct 2028 (Aug 2026)
UFF recognised as second RBI SRO-FT (10 Sep 2026) — tracked in SROTrac
